title: Rexon RTP GUI
description: Advanced Random Teleport Plugin with GUI inspired by DonutSMP but better!
body:
# ⚡ REXON RTP GUI ⚡
## v2.0.0 • Premium Random Teleport Plugin

### Smart Caching • Multiple Worlds • Premium System • Safe Locations

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

## ✦ FEATURES

• Instant teleports with smart location pre-generation
• Multiple world support - fully configurable
• Safe locations only - no lava, water, or void
• Premium player support with reduced cooldowns
• Warmup system with cancel on move/damage
• Damage immunity after teleport
• Bypass permission for staff (not auto-granted)
• Beautiful GUI with custom world icons
• Fully customizable sounds and messages

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

## ✦ CONFIGURATION

World Settings:
• Enable/disable worlds individually
• Min/max teleport distance per world
• Custom cooldowns per world
• Warmup time configuration
• GUI slot position

Safety Features:
• Damage immunity duration
• Velocity reset
• Cancel on move/damage
• Safe location verification

Custom Messages:
• Fully customizable messages.yml
• Unicode support for modern designs
• Configurable prefix system

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

## ✦ DEPENDENCIES

Required:
• Minecraft 1.20+ (Paper/Purpur/Spigot)
• Java 17+

Optional:
• Vault - Economy integration (for future updates)
• PlaceholderAPI - For placeholders (for future updates)

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

## ✦ SETUP

Drag & drop → Restart → Done!

No MySQL setup, no database configuration!
Works immediately with zero configuration required.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
